# Introduction
Unify use-cases into a single-plot, run in scripts:
- `6_Figure.Rmd` : Human lung atlas for club cells into nasal/non-nasal cell splitting, according to authors (proof of concept) :: supported by ISC
- `Heart_atlas` : Human heart atlas for ventricular cardiomycites (vCM) splitting :: not supported by ISC
- `Stressed_Tcells.Rmd`: Chu pan-cancer T cell atlas, focuses on Yost dataset. Show some T subtypes lack of ISC, no reannotation proposed.

Annotations and reannotation (when applicable) has been cached at `cache/`

# Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, 
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6)
```

# 1. Load consistencies
```{r}
cons_files <- list.files("cache/",
                         pattern = ".rds",
                         full.names = T)

cons_keep <- c("ISC_local" = "silhouette | recip_classif:Match",
               "ISC_global" = "2label_silhouette | Pseudobulk:Cosine",
               "SCCAF" = "SCCAF | NA",
               "MetaNeighbor" = "MetaNeighbor_Supervised | NA",
               "cLISI" = "nsa_cLISI | NA")

ct_keep <- c("HLCA_original" = c("club.cell"), # bad based on markers
             "HLCA_reannotated" = c("Club.(nasal)", "Club.(non.nasal)"), # good reannotation based on markers
             "Heart_original" = c("Ventricular.Cardiomyocyte"), # good based on markers
             "Heart_reannotated" = paste0("vCM", 1:5), # these reannotation were all bad based on markers
             "Tstr_consistencies" = c("CD4.Treg", "CD8.p.Tex",
                                      "CD8.Tcm", "CD4.Str",
                                      "CD4.Tcm") # see table below
             )

```

| Cell type  | local_ISC | SCCAF | MetaNeighbor | Gene marker |
|-------|-------|-------|-------|-------|
| CD4.Treg | good  | good | good | good |
| CD8.p.Tex | bad | bad  | good | bad |
| CD8.Tcm | bad | good | mid | bad  |
| CD4.Str | bad | good | bad | bad |
| CD4.Tcm | good | mid | bad | good |


```{r}
cons <- lapply(cons_files, function(f){
   df <- readRDS(f)
   nn <- basename(f)
   ds <- strsplit(nn, split = "_")[[1]][1]
   annot <- ifelse(grepl("reannot", nn, ignore.case = T),
                   "reannotated", "original")
   
   df %>% 
      mutate(method_type = paste(consistency_metric,
                                 dissimilarity_method,
                                 sep = " | ")) %>% 
      filter(method_type %in% cons_keep) %>% 
      mutate(method_type = factor(method_type,
                                  levels = cons_keep,
                                  labels = names(cons_keep)),
             dataset = ds,
             annot = annot,
             dataset_annot = paste(dataset, annot, sep = "_")) %>% 
      select(celltype, method_type, measure, ident, dataset, annot, dataset_annot)
}) %>% 
   data.table::rbindlist()
```
